{
  "name": "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem",
  "version": "2.3.0",
  "description": "MCP server for filesystem access",
  "license": "SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE",
  "mcpName": "io.github.modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem",
  "author": "Model Context Protocol a Series of LF Projects, LLC.",
  "homepage": "https://modelcontextprotocol.io",
  "bugs": "https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/issues",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers.git"
  },
  "type": "module",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=24"
  },
  "bin": {
    "mcp-server-filesystem": "dist/index.js"
  },
  "files": [
    "dist"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc && shx chmod +x dist/*.js",
    "prepare": "npm run build",
    "watch": "tsc --watch",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "format": "prettier --write \"**/*.{ts,mts,cts,js,mjs,cjs}\" --ignore-path ../../.prettierignore",
    "format:check": "prettier --check \"**/*.{ts,mts,cts,js,mjs,cjs}\" --ignore-path ../../.prettierignore",
    "lint": "eslint . --max-warnings 0",
    "typecheck": "tsc -p tsconfig.test.json",
    "coverage": "vitest run --coverage",
    "validate": "npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@modelcontextprotocol/server": "^2.3.1",
    "diff": "^8.0.3",
    "minimatch": "^11.0.4",
    "zod": "^4.2.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@modelcontextprotocol/client": "^2.3.1",
    "@types/diff": "^5.0.9",
    "@types/minimatch": "^5.1.2",
    "@types/node": "^24",
    "@vitest/coverage-v8": "^4.1.12",
    "shx": "^0.4.0",
    "typescript": "^5.8.2",
    "vitest": "^4.1.12"
  }
}
